purpose: Teach: イースト/アーチ/大リーグ/サーモン/マイレージ/聖歌/ダイアナ/カッパ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「イースト菌を使ったパンを焼こう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying, "Let's bake some bread with yeast together."
lines.style: Soft, confiding opening, like sharing a nice little secret. Gentle smile audible, easy relaxed pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと公園のアーチ橋を渡ったよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, I crossed the arch bridge in the park with Dad!
lines.style: Bursting in bright and quick, words tumbling out. Big proud emphasis on crossing the bridge.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「大リーグ中継を一緒に観よう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: And Sho, your dad said, "Let's watch the big league game together."
lines.style: Playfully leaning into the quoted invitation, voice lifting warmly. Unhurried, letting the treat land.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとサーモンの寿司食べたよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, I ate salmon sushi with Dad!
lines.style: Delighted, mouth practically watering at the memory. Fast eager delivery, bouncing on the word salmon.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがマイレージを貯めて家族旅行に行かれるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, I hear your dad's saving up his air miles to take you all on a family trip.
lines.style: Conspiratorial hush at the start, like revealing a surprise. Gentle rising warmth toward the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと教会の聖歌を聴いたよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, I listened to hymns at the church with Dad!
lines.style: A touch quieter, slightly awed, like the big church still impresses him. Earnest and open.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがダイアナ妃のドキュメンタリーを観られたわ
lines.en: You know, Sho, your dad watched a documentary about Princess Diana.
lines.style: Softly reflective, a small thoughtful pause before the princess's name. Gentle, even pace throughout.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとカッパ、つまり河童の絵本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, I read a picture book with Dad about a kappa — you know, the river monster!
lines.style: Excited stumble explaining the kappa, then a proud triumphant finish. Fast, breathless, grinning.
